entries.titleEn: Gossip Goblin’s Crazy Workflow for Building Original Worlds (200M+ Views)
entries.titleZh: Gossip Goblin 如何打造原创世界：《The Patchwright》制作访谈
entries.summaryEn: Zach London explains how an existing story bible, location look development and deliberately constructed shots shaped The Patchwright. The production mixed generated visuals with human performers, editing and custom sound.
entries.summaryZh: 扎克·伦敦以《The Patchwright》为例，讲述如何用既有世界观设定、场景视觉开发和逐镜构图撑起一部短片。生成画面之外，真人配音、剪辑和声音设计同样关键。

skills.label: World bible
skills.summaryEn: Build up characters, objects and lettering before the film so that individual scenes inherit a coherent world.
skills.summaryZh: 开拍前积累角色、道具与文字系统，让每场戏都落在同一个世界里。

skills.label: Visual anchors
skills.summaryEn: Choose a few defining frames for each place before filling the intervening shots.
skills.summaryZh: 先确定每个地点的关键画面，再补齐中间镜头。

entries.titleEn: You’re using Seedance 2.0 wrong (try this massive time-saver instead)
entries.titleZh: Seedance 2.0：Hellgrind 与 Mork 的制作流程
entries.summaryEn: Two Higgsfield production cases illustrate how directors prepare references, coordinate scenes and use Seedance 2.0 for coverage. Hellgrind and Mork offer different approaches to managing a shared world and edit.
entries.summaryZh: 两部 Higgsfield 作品展示了导演如何准备参考素材、协作推进场次，并用 Seedance 2.0 补齐镜头。《Hellgrind》和《Mork》在世界管理和剪辑协作上各有做法。

skills.label: Blocking before generation
skills.summaryEn: Use rough spatial layouts to clarify where people stand and move before generating detailed shots.
skills.summaryZh: 先用简化空间图确定站位和走位，再生成精细画面。

skills.label: Parallel editing
skills.summaryEn: Let scene teams work independently while a lead editor retains responsibility for the full cut.
skills.summaryZh: 场次可以并行制作，但由一位主剪辑统筹全片。

entries.titleEn: The Ultimate Seedance 2.0 Guide to making Viral Films
entries.titleZh: Seedance 2.0 实例：从《Red Rising》段落到概念预告
entries.summaryEn: A Red Rising teaser serves as PJ’s example of condensing source material, exploring looks with Luma’s agent and using selected frames as Seedance motion references.
entries.summaryZh: PJ 用《Red Rising》概念预告说明如何压缩原著段落、用 Luma 的代理探索画面，以及怎样挑选能指导 Seedance 动态生成的参考帧。

skills.label: Scene compression
skills.summaryEn: Choose the lines and actions that carry the dramatic turn before planning coverage.
skills.summaryZh: 先保留真正推动戏剧转折的台词和动作，再安排镜头。

skills.label: Keyframe selection
skills.summaryEn: Curate reference stills for framing, character cohesion and geography before motion tests.
skills.summaryZh: 动态测试前，先按构图、角色一致性和空间关系挑选参考帧。

entries.titleEn: I think I made an official Super Bowl commercial?
entries.titleZh: Grok 超级碗广告征集：一次快速参赛复盘
entries.summaryEn: PJ recounts making a speculative Grok spot for an X-hosted contest and says it placed third. The post is a creator update, not evidence that the entry ran as a paid Super Bowl TV spot.
entries.summaryZh: PJ 回顾为 X 举办的征集活动制作 Grok 广告提案，并称作品获得第三名。这是一篇参赛纪实，不能据此认定作品作为超级碗电视广告播出。

skills.label: Reference-led sprint
skills.summaryEn: Pick a clear tonal reference when you have very little time to communicate a concept.
skills.summaryZh: 制作时间紧时，先选一个能快速统一叙事语气的标杆。

entries.titleEn: I regret nothing except reading the comments
entries.titleZh: 《塞尔达》粉丝短片：角色参考与四格镜头
entries.summaryEn: PJ uses an unofficial Zelda fan film to discuss reusable references, planning in small groups of shots and refining stills before animation.
entries.summaryZh: PJ 以非官方《塞尔达》粉丝短片为例，分享如何重复使用角色与风格参考、成组规划镜头，并在做动态之前修整静帧。

skills.label: Four-frame coverage
skills.summaryEn: Plan a small set of connected angles together and assess them as one scene.
skills.summaryZh: 把互有关联的几个机位放在一起规划，作为一个场次整体检查。

entries.titleEn: 2025’s top AI cheat codes to 10x your videos
entries.titleZh: 2025 年度复盘：AI 影像从分镜到动画
entries.summaryEn: A year-end workflow overview follows a narrative premise through shot organization, character references, multi-panel image exploration and animation.
entries.summaryZh: 这篇年度回顾用一个叙事点子串起镜头整理、角色参考、多格静帧探索和动画生成。

skills.label: Reference economy
skills.summaryEn: Start with a clear close-up and wide view rather than creating every character angle before you know what the scene needs.
skills.summaryZh: 先做清楚的特写和全身参考，不必在镜头需求明确之前穷举角色角度。

skills.label: Coverage comparison
skills.summaryEn: Compare image layouts by how well they preserve both face detail and spatial continuity.
skills.summaryZh: 比较不同画面布局时，同时看脸部细节与空间连续性。

entries.titleEn: Qatar Airways: Making two ads in 14 hours at 30,000 feet
entries.titleZh: 卡塔尔航空：机上协作制作两支广告
entries.summaryEn: This production diary describes a two-spot in-flight challenge in which a prepared brief, real airport and cabin references and distributed teamwork supported fast delivery.
entries.summaryZh: 这篇制作纪实记录了在飞行途中完成两支广告的挑战。已有的创意简报、真实机场与机舱参考，以及团队远程并行，都是能快速交付的前提。

skills.label: Brand fidelity
skills.summaryEn: Photograph the real environment and collect approved references rather than relying on a model to guess the details.
skills.summaryZh: 拍摄真实环境并准备获准使用的参考，别让模型猜测品牌和场景细节。

entries.titleEn: Grandma forgot her clothes and is doing drugs with college kids again
entries.titleZh: Kled 上线广告：用荒诞喜剧做品牌开场
entries.summaryEn: PJ describes a deliberately irreverent Kled launch spot, connecting the audience’s campus context with the product’s premise in a Veo 3 text-to-video production.
entries.summaryZh: PJ 拆解了一支刻意走荒诞喜剧路线的 Kled 上线广告：把目标受众的校园场景与产品卖点连起来，用 Veo 3 从文字生成镜头。

skills.label: Audience-led setting
skills.summaryEn: Choose a recognizable setting that makes the product premise feel relevant to its audience.
skills.summaryZh: 让广告场景贴近受众，用他们熟悉的情境承接产品卖点。

entries.titleEn: This is going to be the next HUGE trend in AI Video (and it’s going to put ESPN out of business)
entries.titleZh: Fantasy Sports Scroll：体育资讯如何做成奇幻周播节目
entries.summaryEn: Fantasy Sports Scroll translates live sports topics into a recurring fantasy-broadcast format. PJ describes how the team builds each episode around scripts, repeatable assets, voice work and a final edit.
entries.summaryZh: Fantasy Sports Scroll 把当周体育话题改编成固定更新的奇幻播报。PJ 介绍了节目如何把脚本、可复用素材、配音和剪辑串起来。

skills.label: Repeatable format
skills.summaryEn: Fix the presenter roles and broadcast grammar so new stories can fit the same format each week.
skills.summaryZh: 固定主播分工与播报语言，让每周不同的内容都能套进同一种节目结构。

entries.titleEn: 120M Views in TWO DAYS: How we made our new viral AI ad for David Beckham’s company, IM8
entries.titleZh: IM8 广告拆解：视觉母题、数字替身与首发
entries.summaryEn: Genre’s case study covers the IM8 spot’s opening transition, branded imagery and use of a digital double. Its audience figures are PJ’s reported numbers, not an independently verified measurement.
entries.summaryZh: Genre 复盘了 IM8 广告的开场转场、品牌视觉与数字替身。标题中的传播数字为 PJ 自述，不是独立核实的统计。

skills.label: Opening image
skills.summaryEn: Use the first visual to tie the campaign’s colors and premise together before the rest of the narrative unfolds.
skills.summaryZh: 在叙事展开前，先用首个视觉把品牌颜色和核心概念连起来。

entries.titleEn: Steal our viral ad formula that got us 100M views in a month
entries.titleZh: Lindy 广告案例：从喜剧开场到产品行动号召
entries.summaryEn: The Lindy office comedy is a case study in building a clear product story around an attention-grabbing opener. PJ also explains how the team reworked a difficult action beat in the edit.
entries.summaryZh: Lindy 的办公室喜剧展示了如何从抓人的开场转入具体的产品叙事。PJ 也解释了团队怎样在剪辑中重构难以生成的动作。

skills.label: Make the hook earn its place
skills.summaryEn: Connect the opening surprise to an actual product benefit before asking the audience to act.
skills.summaryZh: 先让开场的意外与真实产品价值发生联系，再引导观众采取行动。

entries.titleEn: Make an AI TV Show in 15 Easy Steps
entries.titleZh: 《约拿》项目：25 分钟 AI 剧集幕后索引
entries.summaryEn: This post introduces a 25-minute episode about Jonah and links out to the author’s video-rich breakdown. The Beehiiv page is a starting point rather than the complete 15-step guide.
entries.summaryZh: 本篇介绍一部 25 分钟的《约拿》剧集，并把读者引向作者在 X 上发布的完整视频流程。Beehiiv 原文是入口，不是完整的 15 步教程。

skills.label: Frame direction
skills.summaryEn: Separate the performance, depth layers and lighting when describing a single shot.
skills.summaryZh: 描述单个镜头时，把表演、景深层次和光线分开写清楚。

entries.titleEn: Oops, we started the next trend.
entries.titleZh: Popeyes 与 Grok 广告：品牌喜剧与分镜沟通
entries.summaryEn: A recap of spots for Popeyes and Grok leads into PJ’s view on comedy-led branded content, with examples of production shot lists and visual pitches.
entries.summaryZh: PJ 从 Popeyes 与 Grok 两支广告谈到以喜剧带动品牌内容的思路，还举例说明如何用镜头表和动态样片沟通创意。

skills.label: Visual pitch
skills.summaryEn: A short moving example can clarify timing and tone faster than prose alone.
skills.summaryZh: 短动态样片能比单靠文字更直观地传达节奏与语气。

entries.titleEn: I can’t believe Disney allowed us to run this AI ad during the NBA Finals 😂
entries.titleZh: Kalshi 广告幕后：Veo 3 的镜头迭代与剪辑
entries.summaryEn: PJ relates how he designed and assembled a Kalshi ad with Veo 3. The case is most useful for understanding the gap between raw generations and the shots that made the cut.
entries.summaryZh: PJ 回顾如何用 Veo 3 设计并剪成一支 Kalshi 广告。这个案例最值得看的是：生成了许多素材，真正能用的镜头却有限。

skills.label: Generation triage
skills.summaryEn: Review alternatives for performance, readability and sound before committing them to the cut.
skills.summaryZh: 入剪前对比候选版本的表演、可读性和声音，而不是只挑画质最好的。

entries.titleEn: My God, what have I done?
entries.titleZh: 圣经人物 Vlog：短视频形式与 Veo 3 制作笔记
entries.summaryEn: PJ reflects on a series that recasts biblical figures as contemporary vloggers, then discusses social format choices and how he structured Veo 3 shots.
entries.summaryZh: PJ 复盘将圣经人物设定为当代视频博主的系列，并延伸到社交平台的形式选择与 Veo 3 镜头的组织方式。

skills.label: Format as point of view
skills.summaryEn: Give the camera an in-world reason to be there, so the delivery format becomes part of the joke.
skills.summaryZh: 给镜头一个在故事里出现的理由，让拍摄形式本身也成为笑点。

entries.titleEn: Don’t Miss the Veo 3 Gold Rush
entries.titleZh: Veo 3 早期案例：仿药品广告的喜剧反转
entries.summaryEn: An early Veo 3 experiment starts from a recognizable pharmaceutical-ad format and then subverts it. The piece also discusses script review, generation rejects and editorial choices.
entries.summaryZh: 这篇早期 Veo 3 实验先建立观众熟悉的药品广告套路，再将其反转。文章也谈到脚本筛选、废片判断与剪辑取舍。

skills.label: Reset a failing shot
skills.summaryEn: If repeated takes miss the same beat, change the staging rather than endlessly rerunning it.
skills.summaryZh: 如果重复生成仍解决不了同一个问题，就改调度或换镜头，而不是继续重跑。

entries.titleZh: Midjourney Omni Reference：跨场景保留人物外观
entries.summaryEn: This early Omni Reference tutorial tests how a single reference can carry a recognizable identity into different cinematic settings. The headline is rhetorical, not a product comparison.
entries.summaryZh: 这篇 Omni Reference 早期教程测试如何把同一个可辨认的人物带入不同电影场景。英文标题是修辞，不是对两款产品的客观评测。

skills.label: Reference testing
skills.summaryEn: Check the same character across changing framing and lighting, not just in one favored portrait.
skills.summaryZh: 别只看一张满意的肖像；在不同景别和光线里检查是否仍能认出同一个人物。

entries.titleZh: PJ 的 Midjourney 电影感提示词结构
entries.summaryEn: A brief prompting lesson demonstrates how naming the camera treatment and visual atmosphere can steer Midjourney toward the intended cinematic frame.
entries.summaryZh: 这篇短教程展示如何把摄影处理方式和画面氛围描述得更明确，让 Midjourney 更贴近预想中的电影画面。

skills.label: Concrete image direction
skills.summaryEn: Specify the framing and texture you want instead of relying on a generic request for a cinematic look.
skills.summaryZh: 与其笼统要求“电影感”，不如直接交代想要的景别与质感。

entries.titleEn: AI Filmmaking Is Taking Off—Here’s How to Catch Up
entries.titleZh: AI 影像创作入门：PJ Ace 通讯发刊词
entries.summaryEn: PJ sets out the newsletter’s educational focus: public notes on AI filmmaking practice for newcomers and working creators. This introductory issue does not teach a specific technique.
entries.summaryZh: PJ 在发刊词中说明通讯面向新手与创作者，计划分享 AI 影像制作经验。这一期是栏目介绍，不是单项技术教程。

coverage.en: 19 articles from both pages of PJ Ace’s official public Beehiiv archive (April 2025–May 2026). Dates follow the individual article pages. This is an original bilingual study index, not a republication; it does not include unlisted or member-only material.
coverage.zh: 收录 PJ Ace 官方 Beehiiv 公开归档两页共 19 篇文章（2025 年 4 月至 2026 年 5 月）。日期以各篇原文标注为准。本站提供原创双语学习索引，不转载原文，也不包含未公开列出的内容或会员内容。
